name: Michael Gahler - Après le § 3 - Am 9
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 3b. Calls for the EU and its Member States to prioritise diplomatic engagement and to develop a comprehensive peace initiative for Ukraine under the auspices of the UN and the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE) and a structured multilateral dialogue process involving Ukraine, Russia, the EU, the United States, China and other relevant international actors from the global south; underlines that sustained diplomatic engagement is a necessary condition for ending the war and preventing further loss of life;
